question: 12 skilled, 14 semi-skilled and 10 unskilled workers complete a job for ₹13189. If their individual wages be in the ratio of 9 ∶ 5 ∶ 4, then the total money (in ₹) earned by 10 unskilled workers is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Total wage ratio = (Workers × Individual Wage Ratio)

⇒ Skilled : Semi-skilled : Unskilled = (12 × 9) : (14 × 5) : (10 × 4)

⇒ Total wage ratio = 108 : 70 : 40 = 54 : 35 : 20

⇒ 109 units = ₹13189 ⇒ 1 unit = ₹121

⇒ Unskilled workers share = 20 units × 121 = ₹2420

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of skilled workers = 12

Number of semi-skilled workers = 14

Number of unskilled workers = 10

Ratio of individual wages = 9 : 5 : 4

Total wages = ₹13189

**Formula Used:**

Total Wage = Number of Workers × Individual Wage

 Total Wages = ₹13189 (109 units)
 
 Skilled
 Semi-skilled
 Unskilled
 
 
 
 
 
 54 units

 20 units
 
 1 unit = 13189 ÷ 109 = 121
 Unskilled Wages (20 units) = 20 × 121 = ₹2420

**Calculations:**

⇒ Let the individual wages of skilled, semi-skilled, and unskilled workers be 9x, 5x, and 4x respectively.

⇒ Total wage of skilled workers = 12 × 9x = 108x

⇒ Total wage of semi-skilled workers = 14 × 5x = 70x

⇒ Total wage of unskilled workers = 10 × 4x = 40x

⇒ Total wages of all workers = 108x + 70x + 40x = 218x

⇒ According to the question, 218x = 13189

⇒ x = 13189 ÷ 218 = 60.5

⇒ Total money earned by 10 unskilled workers = 40x = 40 × 60.5 = 2420

**∴ The correct answer is ₹2420.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Work and Wages Principle

Wages are always distributed in proportion to the work done. If individuals work for the same time period, the wages are divided in the ratio of their individual efficiencies.

Group Wages

Total wages of a category = Number of workers in that category × Wage per worker.

Compound Ratio of Wages

If the number of workers in different groups are in the ratio p : q : r and their individual wages are in the ratio a : b : c, then their total wages will be distributed in the ratio pa : qb : rc.
